newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST- London-based Arab newspapers-March 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST- London-based Arab newspapers-March 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. trade team in Saudi Arabia to boost investment opportunities.
- Dubai seeks to boost its re-export position and increase its foreign trade by $4 billion.
- Oil ministers from Yemen and Egypt to open a gas field in Egypt on Saturday.
- Jordan-based Philadelphia Bank raises capital to $28 million.
- Kuwaiti Gulf Cables company records $34 million net profit in 1996.
- Investors set up $14 million Middle East International Investment Company in Jordan.
